name: Carmine Potirniche
title: Software Engineer

experience.name: Crytica Security
bullets: Architected and built Crytica's multi-tenant administration platform as sole developer: a C backend service, CLI, and JavaScript/PHP web console with 100+ API operations, from requirements to release.
Designed its security model: privilege-separated services, a schema-validated binary IPC protocol, database-enforced RBAC with per-tenant scoping, and a fixed catalog of 300+ prepared SQL statements.
Built the RHEL 9 installer and setup wizard, rewrote the SSH deployment daemon, and wrote a checksum-verified schema migrator; cut full deployments across 3--12 servers to under 5 minutes.
Orchestrated hundreds of AI agents and subagents, gating their work with code review, 2,600+ unit tests run under sanitizers in CI, and black-box end-to-end installs of multi-server environments.
Led a C synchronization rewrite across 9+ distributed ledgers, cutting sync time by 85%.

experience.name: Relua (relua.us)
experience.role: Founder & Engineer | Desktop video review app
bullets: Founded and shipped Relua, a free macOS/Windows video annotation app; released the v0.1.0 public beta with signed installers for 4 OS/CPU targets, a docs site, and Stripe-funded plans.

Architected a React Native/TypeScript interface over a Rust/SQLite core, bridging native AVPlayer (macOS) and MediaPlayer (Windows) playback through C++/Objective-C++ for frame-exact comments and drawings.
Designed local-first sync over iCloud Drive, Google Drive, and OneDrive folders: a two-way merge of append-only comments with last-change-wins edits that tolerates late or partial cloud writes.
Built the release path: macOS signing and notarization, SHA-256-verified updates with rollback, BLAKE3 content-addressed media, and a harness measuring CPU, memory, and playback.

projects.name: Umbratic
bullets: Built an Electron/React AI workspace backed by a Rust agent runtime and Go model gateway, supporting local inference (llama.cpp), self-hosted models (vLLM), and integrations with Codex and Claude Code.
Implemented an agent execution harness with dependency-aware parallel tools, context compaction, resumable state, bounded retries, cancellation, and permission checks for workspace operations.
Implemented team-filtered Qdrant retrieval (RAG), device enrollment, and revocation for model access.

projects.name: UpDrafted
bullets: Built Next.js/TypeScript recruiting and admin apps with athlete discovery, verification, moderation, Stripe subscriptions, and signed webhooks; enforced 14 PostgreSQL row-level security policies and AES-256-GCM message encryption.
